question: Who fails to experience wonder upon seeing the rising white-and-red branch?
premises: A rising branch appears white and red.
Someone may see this rising branch.
The sight is capable of producing wonder.
inference: No one who sees the rising white-and-red branch fails to obtain wonder.
uncertainties: The symbolic referent of the rising branch is not explicit.
plain_english: Who, having seen the rising white-and-red branch, does not feel wonder?
